notes:
Account snapshot: Clearmantle is a legal compliance SaaS provider serving mid-market to enterprise customers (primarily financial services and healthcare clients). They ingest client contracts, regulatory filings, and investigation documents for e-discovery and compliance review.

Key priorities / asks:
- Need private VPC deployment (will host in customer-managed AWS VPC or air-gapped colo for a subset of clients).
- Indexing scale: initial target 50M documents, long-term 200M+ documents (mix of OCR PDFs, email corpora, Office docs).
- Embeddings + reranking focus — want vector search + learned reranker integrated into query pipeline to reduce false positives on discovery queries.
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile end-to-end query <250ms for typical reranked top-5 queries; exploratory (long-tail) queries can be slower but must not exceed 2s.
- Cost constraints: procurement target ~$0.01-0.03 per interactive query across production load; POC expected to provide TCO model (dedicated vs hosted).
- Retention & compliance: legal hold requirements (retain selected docs for up to 7 years), immutable audit logs per query, exportable audit trail for regulators.
- Security: strict KMS/HSM integration required, SSO/SAML, SOC2/ISO27001 evidence for deployment.

Recent timeline (bullets):
- 2026-01-20: Intro call (Alyssa) — discussed high-level workflow and compliance constraints. Minted POC request. (ff-2026-02-08)
- 2026-02-08: Technical kickoff with engineering + security (ff-2026-02-08-clrm-kickoff). Collected sample dataset and schema.
- 2026-02-25: Security deep-dive; Clearmantle sent initial security questionnaire. (ff-2026-02-25-security-deep-dive)
- 2026-02-28: Received internal legal hold Qs; flagged retention requirement and eDiscovery export needs.
- 2026-03-03: Redwood SE (Priya) completed quick benchmark on representative 2M-doc subset — latency looks promising on Dedicated GPU pool but reranking cost needs profiling.
- 2026-03-09: Pricing & capacity call; procurement asked for formal quote and architecture diagram.

POC plan (proposed):
1) Week 0-2: Ingest 10M doc sample into isolated VPC deployment, run embedding pipeline (quantized model suggested).
2) Week 3-4: Evaluate vector search + learned reranker (A/B vs existing BM25 baseline). Measure recall@10 and rerank latency; profile batching parameters.
3) Week 5-6: Cost modeling + audit log verification; run eDiscovery export scenario and retention workflows.

Open questions / blockers:
- Which reranker model seeds are supported in Private deployment (customer prefers an on-prem/runnable reranker)? Need compatibility matrix.
- Legal requires clarifications on audit log immutability and log retention for subpoena responses.
- Procurement requests line-item pricing for Dedicated reserved capacity and burst pricing for spikes.
